# Applause Reality

> Bank-approved Delhi NCR property, from first site visit to possession and beyond.

Applause Reality is a Delhi NCR real estate consultancy led by Rajiv Kumar Pandey, with 23+ years guiding families, investors and SBI/PNB banking professionals. It shortlists bank-approved residential and commercial projects in Noida, Greater Noida and Wave City (Ghaziabad), attends site visits, handles booking paperwork, arranges home loans through SBI and PNB relationships, and stays on call after possession. Office: B, A-61, Sector 63 Rd, Hazratpur Wajidpur, D Block, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201309. Contact: concierge@applausereality.com, +91 99114 10109.

- [Locations & Projects](https://www.applausereality.com/projects): Compare NCR corridors and the current bank-approved launches in each.

- [Contact and office address](https://www.applausereality.com/contact): Phone, email and the Noida office location.

- [Client testimonials](https://www.applausereality.com/testimonials): Reviews from SBI officers, investors and families who bought through Applause Reality.

## Current launches

- [Godrej Global Business City](https://www.applausereality.com/projects/godrej-global-business-city): Godrej Properties' pre-launch 1, 2 and 3 BHK enclave (~985–2,500 sq ft) on the DMIC corridor, Greater Noida. UP-RERA registration awaited.
- [Hero Homes Leafsong Retreat](https://www.applausereality.com/projects/hero-homes): Hero Realty's three-tower, 3 BHK project (1,656–2,289 sq ft) at Sector MU, Greater Noida.
- [Gulshan Empire](https://www.applausereality.com/projects/gulshan): Wave City, Ghaziabad.
- [Godrej Arden](https://www.applausereality.com/projects/godrej-arden): Sector Sigma III, Greater Noida.
- [Eternia Residences](https://www.applausereality.com/projects/eternia): Tech Zone 4, Greater Noida West.
